messages.author: 93fd7598a6704e7e
messages.subject: Multilevel path modelling
parts: Is it possible to do multi level path modelling in LAVAAN. I am quite new to R --  I was directed to LAVAAN by some friends. If it is possible, is there any resource (previously used codes etc.) which I can use to get familiar with this.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Multilevel path modelling
parts:
On 10/04/2017 07:17 PM, Sunil Sahadev wrote:
> Is it possible to do multi level path modelling in LAVAAN.

Only using the development version of lavaan (0.6-1), can you fit
two-level SEM models (continuous complete data only).

Yves.
